findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "verify_provider" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Verify a provider before using it. Live evidence only; unknown stays unknown.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "verify_provider" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Verify a provider before using it. Live evidence only; unknown stays unknown." → after: "PAID tool ($0.001 USDC via x402, Base). Verify a provider or source before an AI agent trusts or uses it. Returns live evidence only; unknown stays unknown. Send the x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header on the /mcp request; without payment the call returns the canonical x402 challenge (HTTP 402, amount 100"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
